stops.title: Town Green
stops.observation: Find the open green at the heart of this miniature UTown.
stops.discovery: Town Green is a central open-space landmark. The lawn outline and trees here are a simplified procedural interpretation, not a landscaping survey.

stops.title: Education Resource Centre
stops.observation: Look for the light-coloured wings and the glazed facade study.
stops.discovery: This ERC model explores glazing, sunshades and a curved bay. Press F2 to compare the architectural study with the plain massing; all dimensions remain estimates.

stops.title: Stephen Riady Centre
stops.observation: Look toward the broad building complex and its elevated forum study.
stops.discovery: SRC has a separate schematic forum disc and connector. Press F6 to compare the source OSM footprint with the current estimated building geometry.

stops.title: Town Plaza
stops.observation: Find the paved civic space beside the CREATE-area proxy.
stops.discovery: Town Plaza completes the four-stop exploration. Its level paved surface and connecting paths are illustrative only, and should never be used as real-world access directions.
